method: Read actual deployment-listed file bytes in memory and compare local credential/database values of at least 12 characters, including URL password components, JSON-escaped and URI-encoded variants in UTF-8 and UTF-16LE. No values or value hashes are emitted.
limits: This verifies the listed local inputs at scan time against known .env.local values and private filename rules. It is not a general unknown-secret detector or verification of files changed after the scan. Template environment files are allowed but receive the same byte scan.
